attributes.board_name: Idaho Board of Nursing (Division of Occupational and Professional Licenses)

rules.legal_basis: IDAPA 24.34.01 (Rules of the Idaho Board of Nursing); Section 54-1411, Idaho Code
rules.notes: Current rules and the board page set RN expiry Aug 31 of odd years and no CE hours. DOPL began moving licenses to 2-year terms ending on the licensee's birthday from Apr 1, 2026, so dates may change. Board lists a $70 renewal fee (rules cap $90).
